blocks.prompt: 8. Solve graphically: \(\sin x + \cos x = -2\cos x,\ x \in [0, \pi]\)
blocks.explanation:
Kitab kehti hai graph se hal karo, to left side ko ek graph aur right side ko doosra graph banayenge.
Diya kya hai? Equation aur interval \([0, \pi]\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh \(x\) jahan \(y = \sin x + \cos x\) aur \(y = -2\cos x\) milte hain.
Plan: table, graph, crossing parhna, aur aakhir mein exact tasdeeq, kyunke yeh equation simplify ho kar \(\tan x = -3\) ban jati hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin x + \cos x = -2\cos x\), \(x \in [0, \pi]\).
Maloom karna: interval ke saare roots.
Tareeqa: \(y = \sin x + \cos x\) aur \(y = -2\cos x\) ko ek hi axes par plot karenge aur intersection parhenge. Farq \(d = \sin x + \cos x + 2\cos x\) ka sign dekhenge.

Har graph ki shakal
\(y = \sin x + \cos x\) 1 se shuru hota hai, \(x = \frac{\pi}{4}\) ke qareeb takreeban 1.41 tak jata hai, phir \(x = \pi\) par \(-1\) tak girta hai.
\(y = -2\cos x\) \(x = 0\) par \(-2\) se shuru ho kar \(x = \pi\) par 2 tak charhta hai.
Kyun: \([0, \frac{\pi}{4}]\) par pehla graph kam az kam 1 hai aur doosra \(-1.4\) se bhi neeche, to wahan milna mumkin nahi. \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) ke baad pehla graph gir raha hai aur doosra charh raha hai; jaise do log aamne saamne se aa rahe hon, woh sirf ek dafa milte hain.

Table of values (radians, 2 decimal)
\(x = 0\): \(\sin x + \cos x = 1\), \(-2\cos x = -2\), \(d = 3\)
\(x = 1\): \(1.38\), \(-1.08\), \(d = 2.46\)
\(x = 1.5\): \(1.07\), \(-0.14\), \(d = 1.21\)
\(x = 2\): \(0.49\), \(0.83\), \(d = -0.34\)
\(x = 2.5\): \(-0.20\), \(1.60\), \(d = -1.81\)
\(x = \pi\): \(-1\), \(2\), \(d = -3\)
Kyun: \(d\) ka sign sirf 1.5 aur 2 ke darmiyan badalta hai, yani ek hi crossing hai. Shuru mein \(d\) positive hai (pehla graph ooper) aur aakhir mein negative (doosra graph ooper); beech mein kahin dono ne jagah badli hai.
Dhyan dein: \(d\) banate waqt right side ko minus karte hain: \(-(-2\cos x) = +2\cos x\). Yahan sign ki ghalti poora table bigaar deti hai.

Graph bana kar intersection parhein
Figure mein dono graphs yahan milte hain:
\[x \approx 1.89\]
Kyun: Ek intersection point, yani ek root.

2 decimal tak pakka karein
\(d(1.885) = +0.024\), \(d(1.895) = -0.008\)
Kyun: Sign badalta hai, is liye root round ho kar 1.89 banta hai.

Exact tasdeeq
\[\sin x = -3\cos x\]
\[\tan x = -3\]
\[x = \pi - \tan^{-1} 3 = 1.8925\ldots\]
Kyun: Cosine wali terms ek taraf jama kin: \(\sin x = -2\cos x - \cos x = -3\cos x\). Phir \(\cos x\) se divide kiya; yeh jaiz hai kyunke agar \(\cos x = 0\) hota to \(\sin x = \pm 1\) hota, aur \(\pm 1 = 0\) mumkin nahi. \([0, \pi]\) mein \(\tan x\) negative sirf second quadrant mein hota hai, is liye \(x = \pi - \tan^{-1} 3\). Yeh graph wale jawab se bilkul milta hai.
Dhyan dein: Calculator \(\tan^{-1}(-3)\) ka jawab \(-1.25\) deta hai jo interval se bahar hai; us mein \(\pi\) jama karna parta hai.

Tasdeeq
\(x = 1.89\): \(\sin x + \cos x = 0.636\)
\(-2\cos x = 0.628\)
Kyun: Dono sides takreeban 0.01 tak barabar hain.
blocks.final_answer:
\(x \approx 1.89\) radians
Yani is interval mein sirf ek root hai.
